onClick: {{ (async () => { try { const displayName = inpIndividualIdentityDisplayName.text?.trim(); const firstName = inpIndividualIdentityFirstName.text?.trim() || ''; const lastName = inpIndividualIdentityLastName.text?.trim() || ''; const birthDate = inpIndividualIdentityBirthDate.text?.trim() || ''; const reason = inpIndividualIdentityReason.text?.trim(); if (!displayName || !reason) { showAlert('Enter a display name and reason.', 'warning'); return; } if (birthDate && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(birthDate)) { showAlert('Enter the birth date as YYYY-MM-DD.', 'warning'); return; } const rows = await qUpdateIndividualPartyIdentity.run({ display_name: displayName, first_name: firstName, last_name: lastName, date_of_birth: birthDate, expected_version: qIndividualPartyIdentity.data?.[0]?.identity_version, reason }); if (!rows?.[0]?.party_id) throw new Error('No person was returned.'); await Promise.all([qIndividualProfile.run(), qIndividualPartyIdentity.run(), qMembershipIdentity.run()]); resetWidget('inpIndividualIdentityDisplayName'); resetWidget('inpIndividualIdentityFirstName'); resetWidget('inpIndividualIdentityLastName'); resetWidget('inpIndividualIdentityBirthDate'); resetWidget('inpIndividualIdentityReason'); showAlert('Individual identity updated.', 'success'); } catch (e) { showAlert('Identity update failed: ' + (e?.message || e), 'error'); } })() }}
